# Rules extractor model card

> Demonstration documents only. Generated invoices contain fictional vendors and transactions. Public CORD receipts are attributed separately. Browser review practice is local to this device.

## Intended use

Recorded document-intelligence experiments and supervised review practice. This model is not validated for autonomous accounting decisions or arbitrary customer documents.

## Model and training

Deterministic text, layout and keyword rules; no fitted extraction weights.

Recorded populations:

Reference semantic labels are removed from evaluation inputs. Extraction receives the reference document type; classification is evaluated separately. Data attribution is in `data/cord/PROVENANCE.md`; code is Apache 2.0 and CORD retains its CC BY 4.0 license.

## Evaluation

| Population / extractor | Evaluable / scoped documents | Gold OCR field F1 | Tesseract field F1 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| cord / rules | 96 / 100 | 0.635 [0.552, 0.706] | 0.248 [0.178, 0.320] |
| generated / rules | 24 / 24 | 1.000 [1.000, 1.000] | 1.000 [1.000, 1.000] |

These are project field metrics on the recorded test partitions, not the official CORD benchmark metric. Paired comparisons and uncertainty are retained in the manifest. A learned extractor is not presumed better than the deterministic baseline.

## Calibration and routing

Calibration uses validation data separately by backend, field and source population. Generated image variants keep their parent's partition. Repeated variants do not count as distinct parent pages. The published policy uses the rules backend, with all required fields and business checks gating approval. Corrected human values retain their original model score separately.

## Limits and update policy

- Full original CORD 800/100/100 splits are used, with a project-specific subtotal/tax/total and line-item mapping, not the official benchmark metric.
- Generated invoices share four templates; performance does not establish generalization to unseen vendors or layouts.
- Small test populations give wide intervals; the chosen costs are illustrative (review 1, wrong approval 20).
- CORD gold words cover annotated semantic lines; full-page OCR CER/WER includes unannotated text.
- Gold/real OCR input gaps include token segmentation and layout conventions, so they are not pure additive character-recognition loss.
- Rules are conservative on receipts without invoice date, vendor and PO evidence, so those receipts go to review.
- Other-class classification uses generated text tokens; no real miscellaneous mailroom documents were evaluated.
- Extraction measurements condition on the reference document type; document classification is measured separately.
- No live cloud API is deployed. The GitHub Pages demo records this run and stores review practice in the browser.
- Retrain demonstration uses simulated corrections from validation truth; no human corrections are claimed.
- Generated calibration includes controlled image variants from 24 validation parents; these are correlated observations, not new distinct parent pages.
- Unlabeled reference fields are not errors. Document-success rates exclude missing required truth; policy selection excludes unknown outcomes, while review-rate denominators retain the full test inbox.
- Distinct generated parent pages include deliberate duplicate-content pairs and shared templates. Parent-page intervals retain those dependencies and do not establish independent-layout generalization.

The optional retraining command produces an isolated candidate and a before/after report, without replacing the canonical model. Client-declared correction provenance and excluded examples are reported. No automatic promotion, human-review improvement, or paid vision comparison is claimed.
